headline: Brazil's Copom Expected to Hold Benchmark Selic Interest Rate at 13.75%
summary: Brazil's central bank monetary policy committee Copom meets, with financial markets widely expecting the benchmark Selic rate to remain unchanged at 13.75% per year.
why: Banco Central do Brasil's Selic rate determines baseline borrowing costs across Latin America's largest economy, directly influencing commercial interest rates and real valuations.

impacts.name: Brazil Selic Rate
impacts.why: Copom is expected to maintain the Selic rate unchanged at 13.75% per year.
